now.name: AnyGarbs
now.pitch: AI-driven robot swarms that turn any garbage into graded raw materials.
now.detail: Scout drones map every pile. Hauler bots collect it. Sorter bots split it by material using vision, near-infrared and X-ray fluorescence. Container-sized refiners turn each stream into a product a factory will buy, such as compost, biogas, PET flake, copper cathode or rare-earth oxides, and a trading agent sells it. Garbage goes in and feedstock comes out.

shipped.name: designElectronics
shipped.pitch: Open-source electronics CAD for desktop and phone: breadboard, schematic, PCB layout and a simulator.
highlights: A* grid autorouter with vias and clearances, plus DRC
Designs are single offline .dez files that embed every part they use

shipped.name: MyFiles
shipped.pitch: A phone index for paper documents. Scan what goes into each envelope, then search the text to find which envelope holds the paper.
highlights: Document camera with edge detection and on-device OCR
Offline-first SQLite FTS5 search, with records that merge on sync instead of duplicating
Printable QR labels and a self-hosted sync server

shipped.name: RoastIQ
shipped.pitch: Open-source coffee roasting telemetry. An ESP32 streams bean and drum temperatures over WebSocket into Artisan.
highlights: Built for roasting the coffee from our own estate
Bridge and docs are open source
